method: Primary agent inspected all six actual before_fixed PNGs and all six actual after_final PNGs using view_image; no generated scene evidence.

views.overview: Station, platform, freight shed and terrain composition remain; path no longer has the large missing patches; sleepers and the timber crossing read clearly.
views.top_down: Original layout retained, locally realigned path crosses the rail at the new timber deck; loop path and rounded end remain visible.
views.platform: Architecture, windows, benches, lamps and platform retain their previous composition. New track sleepers and crossing visible in the distance.
views.tracks: Sleeper height and rail profile are visible. Final 35/25 lm tunnel fills reveal a little rib structure; the first 900/650 lm capture was too bright and is superseded. A small ceiling light pool and dark tunnel depth remain.
views.path_junction: Large terrain holes visible in baseline are removed. Edge color blends into the meadow; steep triangulated facets, some floating-looking edge shadows, grid silhouette and existing rocks remain limitations.
views.crossing: Timber boards visibly bridge the railway with rail grooves and approaching path. Exposed sleeper sides are visible. Close path borders retain a stepped grid outline.

exit_limitation: All six PNGs, successful manifest, and post-capture package hash confirmation were written before engine shutdown. The process later returned Windows access violation after LogExit/closed-log messages. Clean process exit is not claimed. Prior final scene validation review09 exited 0.
